question: How long will my GCM Safety Net last, and when should I replace it?
answer:
The lifespan of your GCM Safety Net depends on several factors, including the environment and the type of net. However, because we use high-quality, HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene) material, our nets are incredibly durable. All our safety nets in Chennai are also UV stabilized to withstand the harsh Indian sun, significantly extending their lifespan.

Generally, you can expect a GCM Safety Net to last for 3-5 years, which is the period covered by our standard warranty. We strongly recommend a professional inspection every 2-3 years to assess the net's condition. Look for signs of wear and tear, such as fraying, tears, or significant discoloration. Even if the net looks visually sound, environmental factors can gradually weaken the material.
